post.text:
This is Marcus, and his accidental service dog, Gunner.

Marcus served 3 deployments to Afghanistan.  For years, he’s woken up at 3am, drenched in sweat, convinced he’s in back in Kandahar.

Gunner came to the family when his owner passed away, which was a neighbor of Marcus.  On https://t.co/HHY058kJFd

description.description: A three-frame sequence from a night-vision camera shows a dog interacting with a sleeping person in a dark room. In the first frame, the dog is positioned above the person on the bed. In the subsequent two frames, which appear nearly identical, the dog has settled against the person, who has reached up to pet the dog's neck while lying down.
